theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_mt_product_box_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (G : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (E : Set (Euclid P)), σ (Gᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ (G : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in E, σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[k]) → ∀ C B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → MeasurableSet B → ν (G.starProjection ⁻¹' C ∩ Gᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = μHE[k] (E ∩ C) * σ B
